title: Historical bird plates: modern identifications
description: Plate-by-plate modern identifications of historical bird folios: John Gould's The Birds of Europe, The Birds of Australia, The Birds of Great Britain and The Birds of Asia, and John James Audubon's The Birds of America (Havell edition). Each identification carries eBird/Clements, Wikidata, GBIF, Avibase and BirdNET identifiers, with its confidence, reason and sources; unresolved plates are kept with the reason. Cleaned public-domain images of every plate are published as GitHub releases of the same repository.
